upcoming.name: HD Fire Protect
about: Incorporated in April 1997, HD Fire Protect Limited is an Indian manufacturer and supplier of fire protection equipment and systems, offering water, foam and gas-based fire suppression solutions. The Company offers a comprehensive portfolio across eight product categories, including sprinklers, alarm valves and accessories, deluge valves and systems, foam equipment and suppression systems, monitors and nozzles, water spray nozzles, custom-engineered systems and gas suppression systems. Its products cater to industrial, residential and commercial applications, including oil and gas, refining and petrochemicals, power and energy, heavy engineering, aerospace, pharmaceuticals, data centres, hospitality, healthcare and other sectors. The Company develops a majority of its products in-house and focuses on proprietary designs meeting national and international standards.

The Company has over three decades of experience and has established a global presence, with exports to more than 90 countries since inception and 49 countries during the three months ended June 30, 2026. It was the first Indian fire protection equipment manufacturer to receive UL Listing for deluge valves in 1996 and the first Indian manufacturer to receive FM approval for a range of low-expansion foam system products. As of September 2026, it had 21 UL Listed and 87 FM Approved product certifications. The Company operates two manufacturing facilities in Jalgaon and Thane, Maharashtra, covering approximately 8.50 acres, supported by a fire test laboratory and R&D capabilities.

The Company has supplied fire protection equipment and systems to 2,066 customers in Fiscal 2026 and has supplied products for major projects including the Samruddhi Mahamarg, Jamnagar refinery, new Indian Parliament building, Saudi Aramco's Ras Tanura Sea Island site and Oman's Integrated Power & Water Plant Project. Revenue from operations increased from ₹3,729.53 million in Fiscal 2024 to ₹4,892.81 million in Fiscal 2026, representing a CAGR of 14.54%, while its order book stood at ₹1,586.01 million as of June 30, 2026.
As of June 30, 2026, the Company had 279 permanent employees and 253 contractual employees.

Competitive Strengths: Strong product certification and quality track record.
Advanced design, manufacturing and R&D capabilities.
Experienced management team and qualified personnel.
Comprehensive fire protection equipment and systems portfolio.
Track record of profitability and consistent financial performance.
Strong and diversified customer base with long-standing global relationships.
Well-established global presence in a certification-driven, high-barrier industry.

about: Incorporated in December 2007, Ravita Engineering Services Limited is an engineering solutions company engaged in Engineering, Procurement, Installation and Commissioning (EPIC) of HVAC systems, central air-conditioning solutions, air flow systems, chiller plants, industrial compressors, cooling equipment and other electromechanical equipment on a turnkey basis. The Company also provides Operations and Maintenance (O&M) services for projects executed by it and systems installed by third-party solution providers.The Company operates across three areas: Onshore, Offshore and Data Center. Its Onshore operations cover commercial, hospitality, corporate and industrial establishments, while its Offshore operations include rigs, platforms and other offshore marine installations.

During the last three fiscal years and the three months ended June 30, 2026, the Company undertook operations at 6 rigs and 16 associated offshore oil and gas platforms. Its Data Center business provides O&M services for cooling systems, chiller plants, HVAC equipment and mechanical utilities, and it has also secured data center infrastructure work orders aggregating ₹12,000.00 lakhs in Maharashtra.

As of June 30, 2026, the Company had an order book across its Onshore, Offshore and Data Center operations, comprising EPIC, O&M and Hybrid projects. The Company is led by Vibhoar Agrawal, Chairman and Executive Director, and Sunildutt Narayan Goswami, Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer, supported by its Chief Operating Officer and engineering and execution teams.

The Company's revenue from operations increased from ₹1,349.25 lakhs in Fiscal 2024 to ₹27,763.29 lakhs in Fiscal 2026, while EBITDA increased to ₹4,004.92 lakhs and profit after tax stood at ₹2,804.16 lakhs in Fiscal 2026.
As of June 30, 2026, the Company had 399 permanent employees, including 369 in site operations.

about: Incorporated in February 2009, Vaibhav Vyapaar Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) providing unsecured personal loans to salaried and self-employed individuals through its fully digital lending platform. The Company provides personal loans under the “LoanFront” brand through its mobile application, which supports loan origination, customer verification, due diligence, underwriting, documentation, disbursal and repayment. It provides loans through both direct lending and co-lending arrangements with other NBFCs and also generates revenue by providing application and technology services to other NBFCs. Its lending operations primarily cater to salaried and self-employed borrowers, including first-time borrowers and lower-income salaried professionals across urban and semi-urban regions of India.

The Company follows a technology-enabled lending model supported by digital verification, credit assessment, credit decisioning and risk evaluation tools. It has been operating its digital lending business through the LoanFront platform for the last six years. The Company was acquired by CapFront Technologies Private Limited in October 2019, following which it continued to expand its digital lending operations. As of July 31, 2026, the Company had Assets Under Management (AUM) of ₹812.41 crore, net worth of ₹471.96 crore and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80.

As of July 31, 2026, the Company had 56 employees, including 17 employees in technology, 11 in operations and 11 in risk functions. Its operations are supported by an experienced management team with expertise in digital lending and financial services.

about: Incorporated in 2004, Fusion CX Limited is a customer experience (CX) and business process solutions provider offering multichannel customer support through voice, email, chat, social media and messaging. The company also provides AI data infrastructure services, including data collection, data annotation, image and video labelling, and robotic teleoperations.

Fusion CX combines human expertise with technology and proprietary AI tools to deliver multilingual, omnichannel customer engagement, improve operational efficiency and automate customer interactions. Through its subsidiary, Omind Technologies, the company is developing AI-powered solutions for marketing, conversational AI, quality automation and workforce management.

As of June 30, 2026, Fusion CX operated 40 delivery centres across 13 countries , supported customers in 28 languages and served 208 customers, including 22 Fortune 1000 companies. Its key industry verticals include telecom and utilities, healthcare and life sciences, high-tech and travel, banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI), and retail.

upcoming.name: Tonbo Imaging India
about: Incorporated in December 2003, Tonbo Imaging India Limited is a global defence electronics original equipment manufacturer (OEM) engaged in the design, development, and manufacturing of advanced electro-optic, infrared (EO/IR), embedded vision, communication, guidance, and surveillance systems for defence and security applications. The company offers a diversified portfolio of battlefield solutions, including thermal imaging systems, weapon sights, missile seekers, fire control systems, missile guidance systems, targeting systems, and handheld thermal imaging devices.

Products: Tactical systems: These systems are focused on the functions of imaging, surveillance, reconnaissance and targeting.

Platform systems: Two kinds of platform systems – (a) subsystems that can provide observation and fire control capabilities to a range of aerial, ground and weapon platforms and (b) end platforms that actually perform the task of threat neutralization.

Directed energy systems: To counter the threat of drone swarms, they have designed a portfolio of technology components that are being assembled into a high power microwave (“HPM”) platform with the brand name - WaveStrike.

upcoming.name: Bonfiglioli Transmissions
about: Bonfiglioli Transmissions Ltd is one of India’s leading technology-driven companies providing mechanical and electro-mechanical power transmission and industrial drive solutions. The company designs and manufactures high-precision, mission-critical gearboxes and drive systems that are used across a wide range of industries.

Product Portfolio: Its product portfolio includes low, medium and heavy duty gear motors and gearboxes in torque capacities ranging from 13 Nm to 1,400 kNm Helical, bevel, planetary and worm gearboxes and gear motors, electric motors; variable frequency drives, servo motors and drives, and precision drives for robotics & automation solutions.

The business serves three main market segments based on end-use applications, including Industry and Automation Solutions, Off-Highway Mobility, and Wind Industry. In the Industry and Automation Solutions segment, it is among the largest manufacturers of gearboxes and drives in India, serving both original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and end-users.

In India, it operates three manufacturing facilities—two in Tamil Nadu (Thirumudivakkam and Mannur) and one in Maharashtra (Talegaon). Together, these facilities produced over 341,133 gear motors and gearboxes in Fiscal 2025. As of June 30, 2026, we had 215 suppliers in India and 70 suppliers outside India.

The company also offers strong after-sales support through two dedicated channels. This includes a team of in-house service engineers based at our 13 sales offices across India, with three offices located at the manufacturing sites in Thirumudivakkam, Mannur, and Talegaon.

As of June 30, 2026, the company had 71 touchpoints for customer sales and service across India, including three manufacturing facilities, 13 sales offices, 13 authorized third-party service facilities and 44 authorized dealers with 54 outlets. As of June 30, 2026 the company a network of 285 suppliers of which 215 were located in India and 70 were located overseas including in Italy, China, USA and Germany.
As of June 30, 2026, the company had 1,032 personnel involved in various aspects of our operations, which includes onroll employees and contract workers.

about: Incorporated in 2017, Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Private Limited is a technology-led global manufacturing platform. The Company operates as a managed marketplace connecting industrial and consumer enterprises with a global network of manufacturing partners for custom and large-scale production requirements. The company serves across sizes, from innovative startups to mature companies, and across industries, including utilities, renewables, consumer electronics, artificial intelligence infrastructure, aerospace, space & defence, oil & gas, and industrial automation.

The Company follows an asset-light business model and provides end-to-end solutions, including design, supplier matching, quality control, and logistics. The Company’s proprietary platform, Zetwerk OS, enables real-time tracking and transparency across the manufacturing lifecycle. Its key strengths include scalable manufacturing capacity, strong quality control systems, faster delivery timelines, and a diversified global customer base.

It operates across key sectors such as electronics, renewable energy, aerospace and defence, capital goods, and precision manufacturing. Zetwerk has a presence in over 25 countries and a network of 10,000+ suppliers and 1,100+ customers, including Fortune 500 companies. It also operates 20+ manufacturing facilities across India, the United States, and Mexico.
In Fiscal 2026, the company had 1,802 customers, comprising 1,613 customers within India and 189 customers outside India.

about: Incorporated in October 2001, Sahajanand Medical Technologies Limited is a medical technology company engaged in the development, manufacturing and marketing of technologically advanced medical devices, primarily focused on vascular intervention and structural heart intervention. Its product portfolio includes coronary stents, coronary balloons, transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) devices, occluders, renal stents and peripheral drug-coated balloons (DCBs). The Company focuses on research and development, precision manufacturing and clinically supported product innovation. Its flagship brands include Supraflex Cruz, Cocoon and Hydra, serving different areas of interventional cardiology.

The Company operates three manufacturing facilities, two in India and one in Thailand, supported by two R&D centres in India and Thailand. As of June 30, 2026, it had 119 patents granted globally, 78 patent applications in the pipeline and five design registrations in India. Its products were marketed in 77 countries in Fiscal 2026, through direct, hybrid and distributor-led models, with established market presence in India, Europe and other international markets.
The Company reported revenue from operations of ₹12,105.04 million in Fiscal 2026, compared with ₹10,248.79 million in Fiscal 2025 and ₹9,016.04 million in Fiscal 2024.
As of June 30, 2026, it had 1,605 full-time employees, 31 consultants and 707 contract-based employees.

about: Incorporated in 2019, Jio Platforms Limited is a technology-driven digital services company that operates through its subsidiary, Reliance Jio Infocomm Limited. The company provides digital connectivity and technology solutions across India, serving over 524 million customers as of March 31, 2026.

The company has developed a proprietary technology stack with capabilities spanning network infrastructure, software platforms, operating systems, devices, and digital applications. Its services cater to both consumers and enterprises through a combination of digital platforms and a nationwide distribution network.

For consumers, Jio Platforms offers mobile and fixed broadband connectivity, digital entertainment, gaming, cloud storage, smart home solutions, and AI-enabled digital services. Its ecosystem includes platforms such as MyJio, JioTV+, JioSaavn, JioGames, and JioAICloud.

For businesses, the company provides enterprise connectivity, cloud solutions, IoT services, unified communications platforms, managed services, security solutions, and private 5G offerings. Its enterprise customer base includes organizations across banking, utilities, transportation, manufacturing, government, and information technology sectors.

As of March 31, 2026, Jio Platforms and its subsidiaries had 28,163 full-time employees and a portfolio of patent applications covering digital connectivity, cloud-native networks, artificial intelligence, and related technologies.
